packages.title: Make automation tests unconditional

packages.title: Prevent unsafe writes during installation
packages.scope: Split into portable fault injection, privileged Linux loop-device tests, and macOS/Windows native helpers. Cover disconnect/re-enumeration, delayed udev, raw-device fsync, nested USB trees, target-scoped preparation, sudo ownership, CRLF checkout, progress labels and early manifest refusal.
packages.acceptance: Replacing the selected disk after disconnect never receives a write. Seed completion waits for release; only the selected disk is prepared; failure paths preserve ownership and context. Native jobs execute their exact tests without skips.

packages.title: Protect identity, credentials and enrollment
packages.scope: Add crash injection at credential and postbox persistence boundaries, then restart the real process. Use local PKI/TLS and relay fixtures to inspect presented certificates, tenant binding, signed client provenance, registration and old/new catalogue handling. Separate current-firmware and supported-old-firmware enrollment journeys.
packages.acceptance: Identity survives every supported crash point, postbox retries are safe, expired/wrong-tenant credentials are rejected, and denied approval cannot progress. Device-only BLE/enrollment evidence remains explicit.

packages.title: Test mesh failure and recovery across processes
packages.scope: Build one reusable multi-node fixture with delay/loss, carrier changes, clock jumps, restart and publication failure. Use barriers for admission/eviction/cancellation races, plus controlled BLE controller replies. Exercise relay lease renewal, stale bonds, CLI broker retirement and fleet/build-host Cloud fallback.
packages.acceptance: Live requests keep the correct identity across supported path changes; withdrawn/expired state disappears; pending calls finish within deadlines; reconnect succeeds. Repeat race-sensitive cases under -race. Keep one real BlueZ and cross-version BLE run as hardware evidence.

packages.title: Exercise network policy in namespaces

packages.title: Test container and process lifecycle failures
